notes.title: Hotfix: 1.0
notes.content:
Fixed: post process bug on ‘mech showdown’/’rebels 1: ugr 0’ that cause black screen on certain graphics cards

Fixed: player stuck in camera if currently hacked autogun is killed

Weapon  icons are hidden during cut scenes and synckils
